historicalFunctions.saveCash: function saveCash(){let clinic=+$('cashClinic').value,date=$('cashDate').value||today(),total=+$('total').value||0,card=+$('card').value||0;if(card>total)return alert('Multibanco superior ao total.');let dep=$('deposited').value===''?null:+$('deposited').value,c=s.cash.find(x=>x.clinic===clinic&&x.date===date)||{clinic,date};Object.assign(c,{total,card,due:total-card,deposited:dep,depositDate:$('depositDate').value,ref:$('cashRef').value,notes:$('cashNotes').value,status:dep!==null&&$('depositDate').value?'A aguardar validação':'A aguardar depósito'});if(!s.cash.includes(c))s.cash.push(c);save()}
historicalFunctions.validateCash: function validateCash(){let c=s.cash.find(x=>x.clinic===+$('cashClinic').value&&x.date===($('cashDate').value||today()));if(!c||c.deposited===null)return alert('Depósito ainda não registado.');c.status='Validada';save()}

closingRequirement: if(close&&!s.cash.some(c=>c.clinic===clinic&&c.date===date))return alert('Preencha primeiro a folha de caixa.');
